items.label: Equinix RBC Capital Markets conference 2026 (09-29-2026)
items.signal_prefix: CFO Olivier Leonetti on strategy: retail colocation is the focus

set.signal: CFO Olivier Leonetti on strategy: retail colocation is the focus ('The maximum return today for Equinix is to do what we know how to do best, which is retail, colo, small footprint, rich ecosystem'), while xScale stays in the portfolio but is 'starting to be a crowded portfolio'. M&A priorities are land and power on an opportunistic basis (atNorth was one) and tuck-in technology acquisitions to complement the interconnection offering. New interconnection offerings are expected to be priced higher than prior ones; Fabric One lets participants connect 'in seconds, when before it used to take about a month'. He said the raised growth profile to 2029 is not due to the additional CapEx, which 'is going to have an impact on the P&L of the organization as of 2029' and, 'if anything', is a drag before then (a site takes two years to build and three years to fill).

items.reason: 'pays back as of 2029' was an interpretation; the CFO said the additional CapEx will have an impact on the P&L as of 2029 and, if anything, is a drag.
items.evidence: This additional CapEx is going to have an impact on the P&L of the organization as of 2029. If anything, this additional CapEx is a drag because you build a site, takes you two years.

items.label: Digital Realty RBC conference 2026 (09-29-2026)
items.signal_prefix: CFO Matt Mercier on agentic / inference demand in the 0-1 MW business

set.signal: CFO Matt Mercier on agentic / inference demand in the 0-1 MW business: agentic AI is 'still in the early innings', but the last three quarters set records in the 0-1 MW business, and he thinks last quarter was a record for interconnections (cross-connects and ServiceFabric), with a record 0-1 MW quarter in EMEA. Deployment sizes are stepping up: a typical 0-1 MW deployment of 300 kW or below is now greater than 500 kW, and in some cases 1-5 MW 'is now starting to become more of a standard' for enterprise and service provider customers building inference-oriented architecture. Bulk fiber demand is rising as customers connect training facilities into Digital Realty's interconnected, carrier-heavy campuses.

items.reason: Hedges restored: the CFO said 'In some cases, 1-5 MW is now starting to become more of a standard' and 'I think was our record quarter in terms of interconnections'.
items.evidence: In some cases, 1-5 MW is now starting to become more of a standard ... Just last quarter, I think was our record quarter in terms of interconnections.
